extracted.name: Watermelon Salad with Feta
extracted.description: This watermelon salad with feta, arugula, and tomatoes is easy to make for a refreshing summer salad with sweet, salty, peppery flavors in every bite.
ingredient_lines: 4 ounces feta cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instruction_lines: Whisk olive oil, vinegar, and salt together in a large mixing bowl. Add tomatoes, arugula, and red onion; toss to coat. Gently stir in watermelon and feta cheese to serve.
